property_description: specific isobaric heat capacity (J/(kg K)) of the fluid, flow calorimeter
pressure_note: P1 = pressure ahead of the calorimeter, held by a pressure retention valve; stated absolute ('p = 2.6 MPa (abs)', p.207; abstract 'absolute pressures (0.2-2.6 MPa)')
title_as_printed: Heat capacities of aqueous NaCl solutions. Reference data are taken from Smith-Magowan and Wood (1981), Hnedkovsky et al. (2002), VDI-Waermeatlas (2002), Sharqawy et al. (2010) and OLI Systems Inc. (2012) simulation data.

value.what: measured specific heat capacity of the NaCl solution

value2.what: reference value from the literature source named in the block label (Sharqawy and OLI are correlation/simulation outputs)

composition.other_species: degassed demineralized water + NaCl; 'mNaCl/mwater' read as mass ratio salt to water (m = mass; not explicitly defined in the text); ratio reading inferred: 0.0589 -> 1.006 mol/kg, 0.1753 -> 3.00 mol/kg match the literature molality grid (0.5, 1, 3 mol/kg), a mass-fraction reading would give 0.51, 1.07, 3.64 mol/kg

skip_rows.reason: block label rows naming the reference source
VDI block rows with a reference value only and no measured value (0.0753 and first 0.1574)

conversion_needs: mass ratio to molality: m = ratio x 1000 / 58.44 mol/kg
notes: Label rows are the Reference column entries printed beside each block's first row. The measured values repeat across blocks (the same measurements compared against several references): 0.0289, 0.0588, 0.1753 at 47.4 C; 0.0564, 0.1714 at 100 C, 0.1714 at 150 C appear in 3 or 4 blocks; the builder should deduplicate. VDI block: row with 0.0700 has measured value only; 0.0753 has reference value only (value empty); 0.1360 measured only; 0.1574 first occurrence reference only; 0.1574 last row has measured 3605 and reference 3609 and error -0.13, while the same composition in the Sharqawy and OLI blocks is printed with measured 3604 (printed so).
quality_remarks: cp is per kg of solution (not per kg water). Only 10 distinct measurements exist, repeated across five reference blocks (47.4 C/1 MPa x3, 100 C/2.1 x2, 150 C/2.1 x1, 20 C/0.1 MPa x4 compositions). The 20 C, ratio 0.1574 measurement is printed 3605 in the VDI block (row 14) and 3604 in the Sharqawy and OLI blocks; 3604 (printed twice) is preferred. The 0.1 MPa rows lie below the abstract's stated absolute-pressure range 0.2-2.6 MPa (internal inconsistency; keep).
